text: After finding their father dead in the shower, seventeen-year-old Andy and his visually impaired stepsister Piper are [sent to live with the foster mother Laura|trigger|making a new home], whose blind daughter Cathy drowned in the backyard pool. Laura favours Piper, steals a lock of hair from their father's corpse, and keeps a mute boy, Oliver, who [tries to eat a kitchen knife|images|wounded and changing bodies]. Behind a white border around the house, she studies a VHS ritual, [desperate to hear Cathy call her mum once more|wants|getting back the lost].
